sources.title: HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Think-14B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: The 14B Think model is dramatically more capable on any task involving reasoning, coding, or context-dependent understanding. HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Vision-Instruct-3B is a multimodal model that processes both text and images, optimized for lightweight operation with Korean language focus.

sources.title: HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Think-14B · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: HyperCLOVA X SEED 14B Think is a next-generation language model that moves beyond the conventional approach of simply increasing model size to improve performance. It combines HyperCLOVA X's lightweighting technology for building high-efficiency LLMs with advanced reasoning capabilities.
